instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an indoor training room with black mats. On the left, the man in the black t-shirt (R1) is bent forward in a grappling stance with his head tucked. On the right, the man in the white and blue t-shirt (R2) is bent forward with his head close to R1's shoulder. They are locked in a tight clinch, with R1's arms wrapped around R2's upper torso while R2 holds R1's body. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene with neutral colors.
elements: R1 wraps his arms around R2's upper torso in the clinch
R2 holds R1's body while R1 encircles R2's upper torso
R1 keeps his head tucked while R2's head is close to R1's shoulder
R1 and R2 are bent forward in a tight grappling clinch
